question: How much WILL our profit go up next month if we apply every recommendation?

turns.text: The pricing engine does not provide a direct estimate of the total profit uplift across all products and stores when applying every recommendation. To measure such an effect, a randomized pilot test (store-level test) would be required. The engine can provide individual product uplifts and overall portfolio summaries, but these do not account for the interdependencies and real-world complexities.
